text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, not long after the beginning<n>of Shinko
Windy's classic year...

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Hey, isn't that Shinko Windy<n>over there?
She was in the video the<n>academy put up about dirt
runners!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Oooh, did ya hear that, Trainer?! Here<n>I go!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: GRAWR!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
WAHAHAHA! I'm Shinko Windy, all<n>right! You
better not forget it!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Whoa?! Wow, it is you! Wicked! Icheck your Umatter all the time! Thoseprank vids you pull on your trainer areawesome!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Oh? Really now? You really like 'em,<n>do ya?

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
I love them! Look, I've clicked the bell<n>for
notifications and everything! Can I<n>shake your
hand? Please!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems Shinko Windy's fan base<n>has grown to
the point that she gets<n>recognized walking outside.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What's more, her muscles have<n>strengthened
enough that I shouldn't<n>have to worry about them
becoming<n>inflamed anymore.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's time to shift gears and start<n>training in earnest.
When I say that to<n>Shinko Windy...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you really think so?! It's 'cause<n>my
reputation's on the rise, eh? ♪

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Grah ha ha! Time to beat the racin'<n>world black and
blue!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before we start drawing up her race<n>agenda,
there's something important<n>I want to confirm.
choice_data_list: Windy, what is it that you want to achieve?
Windy, what is it that you want to achieve?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
That's easy! I wanna dominate<n>racing so that the
whole world will<n>hear my name and weep!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! I'mma stand on top by<n>puttin'
everyone else beneath the<n>ground!
choice_data_list:
(...Villainous tendencies aside, at least she's
determined?)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: However... Yeah... Hmmm...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: What I really wanna do is stand outforever. I don't wanna be just someflash in the pan.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Now that I'm growin' my fan base,<n>I've realized
something.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Videos and Umatter posts only trend<n>for like a day
or two.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
By the third day, everyone's already<n>moved on to
the next big thing.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: They'll check me out once, then<n>forget all about me.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
And you know what's worse?! The<n>second
there's any news about turf<n>racing, everyone just
switches to<n>looking at that instead!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Grrr! Just thinking about it is startingto annoy me already! I want everyonelooking at me—forever and ever!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the midst of her bout of frustration,<n>I catch a
glimpse of something she<n>hasn't even realized
herself yet: her<n>true desire.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Huh? Forever means forever! I wantpeople talking about me after I'mdone racing and even after I've turned old and gray!
choice_data_list: What do you want them to say?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hmm... "She was a real monster on<n>dirt!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Even when a new talent shows up on<n>the track, the
sinister image of me in<n>my prime should creep into
their<n>minds like a recurring nightmare!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
And it should stay that way for years,
decades—even a century from now!
choice_data_list: You want to go down in history, yeah?
You want to go down in history, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...History?
choice_data_list: Here, take a look at this.
Here, take a look at this.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I grab a book from the shelf and hand<n>it to her.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
What's this? Uhhh... "The Best<n>Umamusume in
History: Fan<n>Rankings"?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ah! ...I know her. And her. And I've<n>heard her
name, too...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Or, really, everyone knows these<n>racers.
choice_data_list: Is this what you're talking about?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
choice_data_list: Being remembered as the best of all time?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: You're right! I gotta get my name<n>written in here!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Lackey! Tell me how!
choice_data_list:
Get strong enough, and the rest will happen
naturally.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: So I just gotta get stronger?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Piece of cake! I'm already strong, so<n>I just gotta
make everyone notice.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: That settles it. I'mma win like mad tillthey have to put me in here!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'll have my name written down at<n>rank one, two,
three, aaaaall the way<n>to one hundred!
choice_data_list: I don't think that's how it works!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But I also don't think I've ever seen<n>her this
motivated before...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Lemme promise you this...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'll become an Umamusume strong<n>enough to top
the rankings even a<n>hundred years from now!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: That's gonna be me! Just you watch!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: That's my new ambition!<n>RAAAAAWR!
choice_data_list: Ambition... I like the sound of that!
Ambition... I like the sound of that!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few minutes later, once Shinko<n>Windy has calmed
down a bit, she<n>asks me a question.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: So, what do I need to do, exactly?
choice_data_list: Get as many wins as you can.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I suggest we aim for the graded<n>Unicorn Stakes as
our first goal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the same length and track as her<n>debut race,
so having that experience<n>should give her an edge.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Sounds good to me.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I'll leave the strategizing to you!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Heh heh heh! Even unicorns arenothing before my fangs! Chomp!
